label: 86 Chaos 17.1.4
notes: Stops the Schedule Builder control deck from overlaying grid cells or intercepting Assign interactions while keeping the day/date row sticky.
Adds locale-independent route and subtab identities so Spanish interface tests do not break later release-gate navigation.
Makes the deployed-version browser assertion follow package.json instead of a retired hard-coded version.
Aligns 86Voice to the exact first bottom-nav baseline on narrow phones and accepts localized Kitchen Command headings without weakening crash detection.
Raises exhaustive route-sweep test budgets to match their observed runtime instead of timing out healthy coverage.
title: 86 Chaos 17.1.4
summary: Targeted repair for the 17.1.3 failed+new Play Store release-gate browser failures and timeouts.
description: Repairs real Schedule Builder and mobile toolbar geometry defects and hardens locale/version-sensitive Playwright contracts using stable application identities rather than fragile English text selectors.
highlights: Schedule Builder control deck remains in normal flow; only the requested day/date header stays sticky.
Drawer, Time Clock, Financials, Prep, Inventory, Maintenance, HR, Settings, and Back Office controls expose stable route/subtab identities.
Spanish testing uses separate project accounts and waits for preference restoration, preventing cross-project language leakage.
System Administrator drawer return uses the stable godmode route identity.
Long Concept 1 route/subtab sweeps receive evidence-based 240-second budgets.
